title: Recovery of encoded unique games
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number and let $G$ be a finite list of unique game constraints. Suppose each constraint has distinct left and right variable indices, and its table is a permutation of $0,1,\ldots,q-1$. Parsing the unique game encoding of $G$ with parameter $q$ returns exactly $G$.
